Updates the CLI and bundled gateway to protocol 68 for the Realtime voice release. Existing terminal commands, names, and rendering are preserved.

The companion iOS app adds Realtime for eligible OpenAI API, ChatGPT Codex, and möbius Cloud providers. The AudioWave01 control replaces dictation for eligible providers and starts a new voice chat beside New Chat. Other providers retain dictation. This app update also fixes stale connection errors on reopening and coordinates dictation, spoken replies, and Realtime audio teardown.

Update gateways and clients together. Binary packages include the gateway, pinned cloudflared, LICENSE, and NOTICE.
